summary: PR 7299 created a new AVM pattern module for Function Apps at avm/ptn/app/function-app. It merged after a long review by AlexanderSehr with about twelve commented rounds.
proposed: The PR body says it fixes Azure-Verified-Modules issue 2721 and adds a pattern module for Function Apps, flagged as a backwards-compatible feature with a MINOR version bump.
changed: Reviewers asked for simplified tests (the defaults test should cover defaults, and non-consumer-relevant items removed) and questioned having both logAnalyticsWorkspaceName and logAnalyticsWorkspaceResourceId, recommending the resource ID and a simplified existing user-assigned identity block. The author simplified the changelog because much of it described mid-session changes rather than versions that exist.
shipped: The new avm/ptn/app/function-app module (README, CHANGELOG, Bicep source and e2e tests) merged in one commit; symbol moves show test dependency parameters carried over from avm/res/app/managed-environment.
